caseNameFull: Walter Gresham v. Arabella D. Huntington, as Executors, etc.

opinions.text: Petition for a . writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. James B. Stubbs and Mr. T. D. Gresham and Mr. Walter Gresham for petitioner. Mr. R. S. Lovett, Mr. Maxwell Evarts and Mr. J. W. Terry for respondents.
